method.incomplete_cells: gates are never computed on incomplete seed sets (no outcome-based deletion); incomplete cells cannot pass and mean-based gates cannot reject them, but a qualified privacy breach on available seeds still rejects
method.interval: two-sided 95% Student-t interval over per-seed paired contrasts (df = n-1); each gate consumes the relevant side (utility: upper; gain/removal: lower)
method.interval_choice: two-sided 95% matches the project's seed-level convention (scripts/stats_utils.py paired_t_test) and is the conservative reading of the draft's upper/lower 95% confidence limits
method.privacy_rule: per required combination qualified in the frozen attack specification: maximum per-seed advantage across the cell's seeds, compared to that combination's privacy limit
method.t_distribution: local implementation via the regularized incomplete beta function (Numerical Recipes continued fraction), the algorithm validated against textbook reference values in tests/test_confirmatory.py

scope: Classification follows the frozen R1 protocol over the declared finite cell set and the declared qualified attack suite. It establishes no universal trilemma, no hardware necessity, and no complete-transcript privacy claim.

finite_set.note: every planned cell has a valid rejection reason; the mixture of utility, gain and privacy rejections is reported per cell
